Question: I am a 18 years old girl ..i have very bad hair..they are long but very thin and doesnot hav any shine...they look bad....same is the case wid my sister..can we cut our hair to diffrent style..like nowadayz lazer.step cutting...and razor..they are so cut ..that the hair looks good...and it also makes look gud....we both do complete hijab alhamdulillah...even i searched on the net there was a fatwa given by some ..that it is permisible.....the mahfoom of hadith are.1- hamein doosre religion ka maushaba nahi karna chahiye...2-girls ko boyz jaisa huliya nahi karna chahiye......and cutting not ur hair is there in sikh religion!!!....so by noy cutting our hair there will be moushaba with the sikh gairls!!!!.....and if still you say that it is not permisible...then at upto way extent we can cut our hair as mine is below hips.....plz help....and plz reply in english..... Answer ID: 6917 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1391/1306=d/1429) Women are not allowed to get their hair cut. قال فى الدر المختار: قطعت شعر راسها اثمت ولعنت. فى الأشباه: احكام الانثى قوله وتمنع من حلق راسها اى حلق شعر راسها الى قوله والظاهر ان المراد بحلق راسها ازالتہ سواء كان بحلق او قص ۔۔۔۔ والمراد بعدم الجواز كراهة التحريم۔ وعن على قال: نهى رسول الله عليه وسلم ان تحلق المرأة راسها، رواه النسائي (مشكاة) قلت والحلق عام للقص ايضا (امداد الفتاوي 221:4) The abovementioned traditions reveal that as it is unlawful to shave the hair it is unlawful to trim it as well. (2) The appearance which is characteristic to any particular people, the Muslims are not allowed to adopt it. Likewise, women are prohibited to wear the clothes and hair which are generally worn by men. Hair for women are naturally a cause of beauty, it is prohibited to get them cut. Therefore it is wrong to think that Sikh girls do not get their hair cut, so the Muslim girls should be allowed to get their hair cut. Muslim girls are not allowed to cut their hair, therefore they should never do it, it is a cause of natural beauty for them. The angels in the skies recite this: سبحان من زين الرجال باللحى وزين النساء بالذوائب He is pure who beautified men with beard and women with locks of hair. (3)You should never get your hair cut as such woman has been cursed (by the Hadith). Yes, if the hair is so long which hang below hips and look ugly, then the hair hanging below hips can be trimmed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
